# ill-be-back v1.0.0

Keep the active OpenCode session cache warm while you are away.

## Install

Two ways:

- Manual: follow the [README](https://github.com/aundal/opencode-ill-be-back#install).
- With an LLM: paste the prompt from [INSTALL_PROMPT.md](https://github.com/aundal/opencode-ill-be-back/blob/main/INSTALL_PROMPT.md) into OpenCode.

Then restart OpenCode and run `/illbeback`.

## Features

- Auto cache countdown after the first assistant reply.
- `/illbeback` arms away mode and sends keep-alive pings until the ping limit.
- `/illbeback-test` measures your provider cache timeout and sets a safe ping interval.
- Sidebar with live countdown, state marker, and net USD savings (`Session` / `Total`).
- Best-effort pricing via models.dev; pings still run if it is unreachable.

## Files

- `src/ill-be-back.ts` - runtime plugin (`opencode.json`)
- `src/ill-be-back.tsx` - TUI sidebar (`tui.json`)
